title: Read a File Asynchronously
question: Read the contents of a text file asynchronously without blocking the event loop.
key_concept: Non-blocking I/O; fs.readFile takes an error-first callback

title: Read a File Synchronously
question: Read a file synchronously and handle the case where the file doesn't exist.
key_concept: fs.readFileSync blocks the event loop; always wrap it in try/catch

title: Write and Append to a File
question: Write a string to a file, then append another line to it.
key_concept: writeFile overwrites the file; appendFile adds to the end

title: Watch a File for Changes
question: Watch a file and log a message whenever it changes.
key_concept: fs.watch emits 'change' or 'rename' events; behavior is OS-dependent

title: Create an HTTP Server
question: Create a basic HTTP server using the built-in http module that responds with 'Hello World'.
key_concept: http.createServer takes a request listener invoked for every incoming request

title: Parse Query String Parameters
question: Extract query parameters from an incoming request URL, e.g. /search?q=node&page=2.
key_concept: The built-in URL API parses search params without manual string splitting

title: Build a Minimal Router
question: Route GET /users and POST /users differently using only the built-in http module (no framework).
key_concept: Manual routing checks req.method/req.url; request bodies arrive as stream chunks

title: Create an Express Server
question: Set up an Express server with a single GET / route.
key_concept: Express wraps the http module with routing and middleware conveniences

title: Write Logging Middleware
question: Write Express middleware that logs the method and URL of every request.
key_concept: Middleware runs in registration order; call next() to continue the chain

title: Write Centralized Error-Handling Middleware
question: Add a centralized error handler in Express that catches errors thrown in any route.
key_concept: Express identifies error-handling middleware by its 4-argument signature (err, req, res, next)

title: Implement a Custom EventEmitter
question: Implement a minimal EventEmitter class supporting on() and emit().
key_concept: An event emitter maps event names to arrays of listener callbacks

title: Use Node's Built-in EventEmitter
question: Use Node's events module to emit and listen for a custom 'orderPlaced' event.
key_concept: Extending EventEmitter is the idiomatic way to build event-driven Node classes

title: Read a Large File with Streams
question: Read a large file in chunks using a readable stream instead of loading it entirely into memory.
key_concept: Streams process data in chunks, keeping memory usage constant regardless of file size

title: Pipe a Readable Stream to a Writable Stream
question: Copy a file by piping a readable stream directly into a writable stream.
key_concept: pipe() manages backpressure automatically between readable and writable streams

title: Create a Custom Transform Stream
question: Create a Transform stream that uppercases text as it flows through the pipeline.
key_concept: Transform streams implement _transform() to modify data mid-pipeline

title: Promisify a Callback-Based Function
question: Convert Node's callback-based fs.readFile into a Promise-based function.
key_concept: util.promisify wraps error-first callback functions into Promise-returning ones

title: Run CPU-Intensive Work Off the Main Thread
question: Offload a CPU-heavy calculation to a worker thread so it doesn't block the event loop.
key_concept: worker_threads run JS in parallel threads — ideal for CPU-bound work, unlike the async I/O the event loop is built for

title: Fork a Child Process
question: Spawn a child process and exchange messages with it.
key_concept: fork() creates a new Node process with a built-in IPC channel for message passing

title: Hash a Password
question: Securely hash a password using Node's built-in crypto module.
key_concept: scrypt is a slow, memory-hard hash designed to resist brute-force attacks; always store a unique salt per password

title: Sign and Verify Data with HMAC
question: Create a signed token using HMAC and verify it hasn't been tampered with.
key_concept: HMAC signatures let you detect tampering without encrypting the payload — the basis of how JWTs are signed

title: Simple In-Memory Rate Limiter
question: Write Express middleware that limits each IP to 5 requests per 10 seconds.
key_concept: A fixed-window counter per key (IP) is the simplest rate-limiting strategy; production systems use Redis for shared state across instances

title: In-Memory Response Caching Middleware
question: Cache GET responses in memory for 30 seconds to avoid recomputing expensive results.
key_concept: Wrapping res.json lets middleware intercept the response without changing the route handler
